This is corroborated by the `animal_pose_auditor`'s low confidence in limb keypoints. Secondary artifacts include melting in the neck/shoulder region and painterly/smudged facial features (Severity 3). These structural and textural anomalies indicate a high degree of AI generation error, leading to a very low artifact score.
